blocks.text: To edit a consoles policy rule:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Privileged Remote Access > Consoles Policy.
Locate the consoles policy rule you want to modify and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: If you only want to change a consoles policy rule's place in the Rule Order, you can manually enter a new value in the About Consoles Policy.

blocks.item: In the Edit Rule window, modify fields as necessary. For more information about each field, see Configuring Consoles Policies.

blocks.text: To learn more about PRA, see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.
